subtitle: Controle, dimensionamento e distribuição de servidores da Rede Municipal de Ensino
archetype: SWISS & INSTITUTIONAL LUXURY (Authority, Civic Integrity & Precision)

theme_strategy.description: Institutional government dashboard for Municipal Secretariat of Education. Light theme primary for daily office use with high contrast, with dark mode toggle for low-light management environments.

rules: Use #0B192C (Azul-Marinho) for primary sidebar, institutional header banners, and high-impact indicators.
Use #D4AF37 (Dourado Institucional) for badges, subtle card accent lines, verified seals, active navigation indicators, and primary action buttons.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or sticky headers. Use backdrop-blur-md with solid/semi-solid navy or white base.
Ensure all status colors (Verde=Disponível, Azul=Ocupado, Amarelo=Reservado, Vermelho=Déficit, Roxo=Excedente) maintain WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast against their card backgrounds.
Do NOT use Inter for main titles/headings — use Plus Jakarta Sans with bold/extra-bold weights.
Use monospaced font (JetBrains Mono / Source Code Pro) for Matrícula IDs, CPF fields, matrix grade values (MAT I..FASE IX), and numerical KPI counts.
Keep section headers punchy and left-aligned with a subtle gold left border (border-l-4 border-[#D4AF37] pl-3).

sidebar.style: Fixed left navigation with collapsed option. Background: #0B192C with gold accent active indicators.

layout_and_grids.distribution_table: Overflow horizontal table layout with sticky school name column on left, scrollable matrix columns (MAT I to FASE IX, Total, Vagas, Déficit/Excedente) on right.

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 rounded-xl p-5 relative overflow-hidden
cards.accent: Top subtle 2px border accent in gold (#D4AF37) or status colors.

tables.style: Dense, professional data grid with hoverable rows, sticky headers (bg-[#0B192C] text-white), zebra-striping option, and sticky status badges.
tables.editable_cells: Inline editing for Quadro de Distribuição Escolar with instant visual highlight for changes.

steps: 1. Upload de Arquivo (XLSX, XLS, CSV, PDF)

query_assistant.type: Rule-based search helper chat modal / slide-over (Sem IA Generativa, baseado estritamente em filtros de banco de dados e regras de negócio da Educação).

auth.provider: Clerk Integration (SignIn / UserButton components wrapped in institutional layout with Municipal coat-of-arms branding).

image_urls.description: Educational institution building background for login banner and municipal dashboard headers
Clean school interior hallway image for report headers and detail cards

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive components, form inputs, metric displays, buttons, modal triggers, and navigation links MUST include a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user interfaces use pure Portuguese (pt-BR) terminology standard in Brazilian Municipal Education Secretariats (e.g., Matrícula, Servidor, Vagas Autorizadas, Vagas Excedentes, Déficit, Etapa de Ensino, MAT I, FASE IX, Quadro de Distribuição Escolar).
Strictly follow code style with .js / .jsx React components (not TypeScript .tsx files).
Integrate Lucide React icons for intuitive navigation: LayoutDashboard, FileSpreadsheet, Users, Table, GitCompare, BookmarkCheck, Sliders, Building2, Bot, FileText, ShieldAlert, UserCheck, LogOut.
Ensure the Quadro de Distribuição Escolar table allows side-by-side editing of teacher allocation per stage (MAT I to FASE IX) with automatic row/column summing.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for feedback on actions like creating/canceling reservations, saving distribution matrices, and importing files.
Ensure full responsiveness across desktop, laptop, tablet, and mobile views with collapsible sidebar drawer on small screens.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Create distinctive frontends that feel premium, trustworthy, and institutional.
Dark navy blue (#0B192C) with gold details (#D4AF37) provides high visual authority.
Layered shadows and 1px crisp borders elevate the interface from standard Bootstrap/Tailwind slop.
Never use transparent dropdowns or popovers — assign bg-white or bg-slate-900 with clear borders.
Every button and interactive card must have smooth hover and focus transitions (e.g., transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5).
